copy_hint: Copy keeps the originals here. On the destination sheet, choose Paste and click the center of the group. You can paste the group again.
cut_hint: Cut holds the items here until you paste. On the destination sheet, choose Paste and click where the center of the group should land.
point: Click where the center of the group from {0} should land on {1}. Esc cancels.
legend_target: Legend on {0}. Cancel keeps the clipboard and stops this paste.
column_target: Graphical column schedule on {0}. Cancel keeps the clipboard and stops this paste.
empty: The clipboard for this project is empty. Cut or copy placements on a sheet first.
open_sheet: Open a drawing sheet in a writable Revit project.
no_items: There are no eligible placements on this sheet.
selection_failed: The paste succeeded. Revit could not select the placed items.
wrong_sheet: The item does not belong to this sheet.
grouped: The placement belongs to a group.
revision: The revision schedule belongs to a title block.
changed: The placement changed on its source sheet.
